description: This file defines the FormattedTextFrame class, which implements the IAreaProvider interface to manage formatted text rendering within the MigraDoc document rendering system. It handles layout calculations, rendering info management, and area provisioning for text frames.

classes.name: FormattedTextFrame
classes.description: Represents a formatted text frame that provides layout and rendering information for text elements in a document.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Performs formatting of the text frame using the provided graphics context.

methods.name: GetRenderInfos
methods.description: Returns the array of render information objects for the text frame.

methods.name: CalcContentRect
methods.description: Calculates the rectangle area for the content based on text orientation, margins, and line formatting.
